abilities.katana.description: A curved blade, keen at the edge.
abilities.snag.description: Snags a foe with the whip and drags it close.
abilities.grenade.description: Lobs a charge that blasts foes a step back.
abilities.repulse.description: A burst of force that hurls back every foe beside it.
abilities.whirlwind.description: A spinning cut at every foe around.
abilities.punch.description: A plain punch, while the mind gathers itself.
abilities.scratch.description: A rake of cold, spectral nails.
abilities.heal_ally.description: Mends the hurt ally lowest on health, itself included.
abilities.dash.description: A burst of speed toward the fight.
abilities.cleaver.description: A butcher's blade; its cuts bleed.
abilities.chain_lightning.description: Arcs foe to foe, weaker each jump.
abilities.raise_dead.description: Raises ghouls, three at most, higher in level with magic.
abilities.molotov.description: A thrown firebomb; burns longer with luck.
abilities.inspire.description: Nearby allies move faster and defend better.
abilities.swipe.description: A quick swipe of the claws.
abilities.pounce.description: Leaps on a foe three or four cells off and strikes as it lands.
